newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan buys 1-2 reformate cargoes at $27.90/bbl.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan buys 1-2 reformate cargoes at $27.90/bbl.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has bought "more than one" 250,000-barrel cargoes of 95-octane unleaded reformate for March 16-30 delivery at around $27.90 per barrel on a cost-and-freight basis, a company official said on Wednesday.
The official would not comment on the exact number of cargoes or the winners.
The tender sought offers on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis to Keelung, Taichung, Kaohisung or Shalung by February 18 and was be valid until February 20.
CPC's purchase of unleaded reformate was even higher than its last record purchase, for one cargo for March 1-15 at $27.60 per barrel c-and-f.
